- ZIP validation covers normalized paths, links, encryption, duplicates, CRC integrity, arch"},{"id":"p41s4","text":"ive depth, expansion size, and compression ratio.
- Office XML validation covers declarations, entit"},{"id":"p41s5","text":"ies, and relationship targets.
- Type detection uses magic bytes and container structure.
